notes.subject: התנשמת
notes.rationale: Sepedi: 'ye tshweu' (swan/KJV, white owl/BSB, horned owl/ASV) — lentšu le ka bolela gape lentšu la gagabadi (lizard, Lev 11:30)

notes.subject: הכוס
notes.rationale: Nonyana ya bosigo — 'little owl' go feta 'cup' (bolelo bja motheo bja lentšu)

notes.subject: maina a dinonyana
notes.rationale: Maina a Seheberu a dinonyana tše di ganwago a sa tepa nyaka; dipheto tša Sepedi ke melaometoro, e sego maina a tlwaelegilego

translation: ⟨את⟩ nonyana ya bosigo ye nnyane le ⟨את⟩ ye kgolo, le ye tshweu;
